video_title: Full 2025-26 Spurs End of Season Interviews: Dylan, Stephon, Julian, De'Aaron, Keldon, Luke

quotes.speaker: Dylan
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan on his first NBA playoff experience and future growth
quotes.excerpt: It's my first year and you can't keep moving forward if you don't have a positive attitude.
quotes.quote: It meant a lot. I think a whole lot to grow on, a whole lot to learn on. At the end of the day, it's my first year and you can't keep moving forward if you don't have a positive attitude. Obviously we lost and I wanted to win that, but at the end of the day, I got to regroup, bounce back, and get ready for next year.

quotes.speaker: Stephon
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon on the team's playoff run and building for next season
quotes.excerpt: I wouldn't look at this season as a failure. I feel like we did a lot of good.
quotes.quote: I wouldn't look at this season as a failure. I feel like we did a lot of good this season, but obviously we didn't accomplish the main goal. I'm just trying to use it as fuel to the fire for next season.

quotes.speaker: Julian
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian on the team exceeding expectations during the season
quotes.excerpt: I don't think anybody pegged us to be in the championship come November when the game started.
quotes.quote: I don't think anybody pegged us to be in the championship come November when the game started. I think everybody was kind of like, oh maybe playing, maybe playoffs. So I think we exceeded expectations. Obviously we didn't exceed our expectations. We wanted a championship, that's kind of what we wanted, but it's a special group.

quotes.speaker: De'Aaron
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron on team togetherness and chemistry throughout the season
quotes.excerpt: I think just the togetherness. Obviously coming into this year, we didn't think that we'd win 60 games.
quotes.quote: I think just the togetherness. Obviously coming into this year, we didn't think that we'd win 60 games or be here, and I think the talent gelled together quickly. I think guys loved each other and it made playing together easier.

quotes.speaker: Keldon
quotes.summary_phrase: Keldon on competing at the highest level and future improvement
quotes.excerpt: There's a lot to take from it knowing that we could compete at the highest level this year.
quotes.quote: There's a lot to take from it knowing that we could compete at the highest level this year. But it definitely sucks, you know, it was right there and I feel like every game we were right there. It hurts to be so close but so far.

quotes.speaker: Luke
quotes.summary_phrase: Luke on the team's playoff exit and respect for the opponent
quotes.excerpt: Obviously it's difficult. A lot of close games that we weren't able to get wins in.
quotes.quote: Obviously it's difficult. A lot of close games that we weren't able to get wins in. Yeah, obviously just tough. The season just ended but congratulations to New York, they played well, they're a good team and they deserve to win.
